title: Monthly Outbound Transfer Allowances, VPS and Dedicated Servers
content:
Every server in the VPS and Dedicated Servers range includes an amount of outbound transfer per calendar month, in terabytes. Outbound transfer above the included amount in a calendar month is priced per started TB.

| Tier | Outbound transfer included per calendar month (TB) | Price per started TB above the included amount (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Harborline VPS 2 GB | 2 | 10.00 |
| Harborline VPS 4 GB | 4 | 10.00 |
| Harborline VPS 8 GB | 5 | 10.00 |
| Harborline VPS 16 GB | 8 | 10.00 |
| Harborline Dedicated Standard | 20 | 5.00 |
| Harborline Dedicated Enterprise | 50 | 5.00 |

## Notes to the schedule

- The allowance is set per calendar month, not per billing term; a 12-month term carries the monthly allowance in each calendar month.
- The overage price is per started TB: any part of a terabyte above the included amount counts as one whole TB.
- The four Harborline VPS tiers share one overage price, and the two Harborline Dedicated tiers share another.
